newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq second-quarter share volume down.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq second-quarter share volume down.

text.p: The Nasdaq stock market said Tuesday that share volume averaged 592.8 million shares per day in the second quarter, down 1.7 percent from 602.9 million during the same period last year.
However, the exchange said in a statement that the dollar volume was $16 billion a day, up 15.1 percent from $13.9 billion a year ago.
The market value of the more than 5,530 companies listed on Nasdaq stood at $1.68 trillion, up 10.8 percent from the end of 1996, it added.
